groups.name: Shows structured around a single unsolved murder investigated across an entire season
groups.explanation: Broadchurch, Gracepoint, The Killing, and Top of the Lake all follow detectives investigating one murder across a full season, with resolution only at the finale. Gracepoint is the American remake of Broadchurch, adding a satisfying misdirection trap.
